messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in GPU OOMs in us-west-2 serving pool (prefill-heavy). 42 container restarts in last 12m. pager triggered for @maya_oncall :rotating_light:

maya_oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs now, starting triage. any customer impact visible?

sierra_sre: seeing elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate for model xg-large-prefill, errors correlate with long-context requests (>64k tokens). metrics: container_restarts +1200% vs baseline.

eric_runtime: confirmed OOM pattern: prefill allocation skyrockets when seq_len > 32k due to kv cache retention. suspect a regression in recent kernel selection path (quantized allocator).

leo_support: we have 3 customers on Dedicated in us-west-2 reporting timeouts, CS flagged: "heavy prompt generator jobs interrupted". prepping comms.

jen_cs: rough ETA for mitigation? customers asking if data or outputs lost.

maya_oncall: immediate plan: (1) route long-context traffic to fallback smaller variant (xg-medium) with forced max_prefix trim, (2) scale down prefill batch_size, (3) cordon busiest nodes and drain pods to stop noisy restarts.

rohit_devops: I can flip routing to fallback model via routing policy for requests matching header x-prefill-long: true. patching now. api call:

```
POST /admin/routing/policy/apply
{
  "selector": "region:us-west-2 and prefills:long",
  "action": "route_to:xg-medium",
  "ttl": 600
}
```

ops-bot: ACTION: routing policy applied (policy-id: rtm-2026-0317-01). Next 10m traffic will shift.

maya_oncall: starting evict on nodes gpu-uw2-3..5, cordon->drain -> restart runtime after stable. will monitor restarts count.

sierra_sre: telemetry snapshot (most recent):
```
metric: gpu_prefill_oom_count = 42 (12m)
metric: container_restarts = 38 (12m)
metric: p50_prefill_latency = 280ms
metric: error_rate_5xx = 4.6%
```

eric_runtime: sharing relevant log snippet from crashed container:
```
[2026-03-17T01:14:02Z] WARN runtime: prefill_alloc_request size=512KiB seq_len=65536 model=xg-large-prefill
[2026-03-17T01:14:02Z] ERROR runtime: cudaOutOfMemory: failed to allocate 7.2 GiB
[2026-03-17T01:14:03Z] ERROR containerd: process exited (OOM)
```

leo_support: customers affected list compiled, sending preliminary note: "We're investigating an infrastructure issue impacting long-context requests in us-west-2. We're routing your jobs to a smaller model while we mitigate. No data deletion observed."

jen_cs: good. please keep me posted if we need an incident status page update.

maya_oncall: mitigation progress: routing shift completed, draining nodes in progress (3/3 cordoned). restarts dropping from 6/min to 1/min. keeping autoscaler paused for these nodes.

rohit_devops: applied temporary prefill_trim override to runtime config: max_prefix_tokens=32768 for xg-large-prefill to avoid extreme allocs. will revert after root cause. config diff: `runtime.prefill.max_prefix_tokens: 65536 -> 32768`

ops-bot: NOTE: cluster-autoscaler muted for nodes under drain (reason: incident-mitigation).

sierra_sre: quick ask — can we add a short-circuit: if prefill_seq_len > 48k, return 413 or redirect automatically? avoids OOM while we patch allocator.

eric_runtime: yes we can add a runtime guard in the request pipeline. I'll open a hotpatch and coordinate deploy to us-west-2 only.

maya_oncall: hotpatch plan: add seq_len guard + graceful 413 + instrumentation to log offender request id. roll 2 nodes, monitor 5m, then sweep.

leo_support: CS prepared a customer update draft, pinging for review.

jen_cs: reviewed and OK. include apology + mitigation + expected followup in 2 hours.

eric_runtime: hotpatch PR created: `runtime/guards/prefill_seq_guard`. deploying to canary node now. snippet: 
```
if (req.seq_len > 49152) {
  return error(413, "Request exceeds supported prefix length. Try smaller context or use streaming / chunked prompts.");
}
```

maya_oncall: canary looks clean. no restarts on canary after 10m. starting rollout to remaining nodes (region-only).

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigations applied. error rate dropped to 0.9% in 15m window. continue monitoring.

sierra_sre: follow-up action items: (1) root-cause trace of allocator regression, (2) add automatic routing rule for very-long-prefills, (3) unit/regression tests for prefill memory estimating.

eric_runtime: I'll revert kernel selection change from last deploy and run profiler. rolling revert scheduled 2h from now unless customers still impacted.

leo_support: customers notified with mitigations, one wants a postmortem. tagging them in follow-up.

maya_oncall: closing pager, assigning follow-up tickets: INF-4523 (allocator revert), INF-4524 (routing rule), INF-4525 (CS postmortem). keeping channel open for 60m for any late regressions. :white_check_mark:
